items.q: How do you charge for junk removal?
items.a: We charge based on the volume of junk you need removed — how much space it takes up in our truck. The price includes all labor, transport, and disposal fees. We provide free, no-obligation on-site estimates.

items.q: What happens to my junk after it's removed?
items.a: We're committed to eco-friendly practices. We sort through everything we haul — donating usable items to local charities and recycling as much as possible before heading to the landfill.
Yes! We offer same-day service based on availability. Book before noon and we can be there before dusk. Call to confirm availability.

story.h2: Premium junk removal you can trust
story.p1: Julio Junk Removal was founded with a simple mission: make decluttering effortless for homeowners and businesses alike. What started as a one-truck operation has grown into a trusted local service with hundreds of satisfied clients.
story.p2: We believe junk removal shouldn't be stressful. From the moment you call to the moment we sweep up after ourselves, our team delivers a premium, worry-free experience every single time.

items.title: Professionalism first
items.copy: Every job is handled with care, punctuality, and respect for your property.

items.title: Eco-friendly commitment
items.copy: We donate, recycle, and divert as much as possible from landfills on every job.

items.title: Transparent pricing
items.copy: No hidden fees. We provide upfront estimates with no obligation to book.

items.title: Community driven
